name: urn:google:agent:orbit-499212:us-central1:sophisticated-book-management
description: Enterprise multi-agent reading concierge that synchronizes Goodreads shelves, tracks Libby digital library holds with Kindle delivery, detects high-discount Amazon Kindle deals, and facilitates book club discussions with strict Human-In-The-Loop (HITL) approval governance.

skills.name: Goodreads Shelf & Reading Tracker
skills.description: Retrieves Want-to-Read (TBR) books, syncs reading progress, and tracks active book club group memberships.
examples: Show my Goodreads Want to Read list
What books are on my reading list?

skills.name: Libby Digital Library Catalog & Holds
skills.description: Cross-references TBR titles across connected US library systems, calculates wait times, verifies Kindle direct delivery compatibility, and queues hold placements.
examples: Check Libby availability for Project Hail Mary
Place a library hold on Tomorrow and Tomorrow
What library books do I currently have on hold?

skills.name: Kindle Deals & Price Drop Monitor
skills.description: Monitors Amazon Kindle Daily and Monthly Deals matching user TBR lists, calculates discount thresholds (>50% or <=$2.99), and submits purchase recommendations.
examples: Are there any Kindle deals on my TBR list today?
Check price drops on my books
Show top discounts on my wishlist

skills.name: Book Club Discussion Coordinator
skills.description: Tracks reading milestones across multiple book clubs, generates engaging thematic discussion prompts, and prepares forum drafts for human review.
examples: Draft book club discussion questions for Demon Copperhead
What is our reading assignment this month?
Post a discussion thread for Modern Masterpieces

skills.name: Human-In-The-Loop Safety Gate
skills.description: Enforces enterprise governance by classifying risk levels (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH) and capturing explicit human confirmation via A2UI interactive cards before executing mutations.
examples: Review pending Kindle purchases and Libby holds

tools.name: fetch_goodreads_tbr
tools.description: Fetches books from user's Goodreads Want to Read shelf.

tools.name: fetch_goodreads_groups
tools.description: Fetches user's active Goodreads Book Clubs and current group picks.

tools.name: search_libby_availability
tools.description: Queries linked US library systems in Libby for digital Kindle edition availability and wait times.

tools.name: place_libby_hold
tools.description: Places a digital hold on Libby for a library book (Requires HITL approval).

tools.name: check_kindle_deals
tools.description: Scans Amazon Kindle Deals feed for discounted books matching user TBR list.

tools.name: execute_kindle_deal_purchase
tools.description: Executes 1-Click Amazon Kindle purchase for a book deal (Requires HITL approval).

tools.name: generate_discussion_prompts
tools.description: Generates thoughtful, engaging discussion prompts for a book club reading section.

tools.name: publish_goodreads_group_post
tools.description: Publishes approved discussion post to Goodreads Group forum (Requires HITL approval).
